# Reversing MCP — Full Reference

FastMCP 3.4 server for static binary analysis and Directmedia format reversing.  
Ports: backend `:10750`, frontend `:10751`.

## Quick start

```powershell
uv run python -m reversing_mcp.server           # stdio mode (Claude Desktop)
uv run uvicorn reversing_mcp.server:app --port 10750  # HTTP mode
```

## Tools (17)

### Binary analysis
- `analyze_binary(file_path, tools=None)` — multi-tool analysis. tools: ida, ghidra, r2, binwalk, static, strings, file. Returns file_path, file_size, tools_used, results.
- `extract_strings(file_path, min_length=4, encodings=None)` — extract ASCII/Unicode strings. Returns list of {offset, string, encoding, length}.
- `get_hexdump(file_path, offset=0, length=256)` — hex dump at byte offset. Returns file_path, offset, length, hexdump.
- `analyze_entropy(file_path, block_size=256)` — Shannon entropy per block. Detects compressed/encrypted sections. Returns overall_entropy, entropy_map, compressed_regions, random_regions.
- `find_functions(file_path, tool="auto")` — function discovery via radare2 or headless Ghidra. Returns list of {address, name, size, tool}.

### File / PE
- `get_file_info(file_path)` — file metadata. Returns path, size, type, permissions, readable/writable/executable.
- `analyze_pe_file(file_path)` — Windows PE structure. Returns machine, num_sections, dos_stub_size.

### Agent RE (sidecar)
- `rea_investigate(target=None, kind="auto", provider=None, query=None, symbol=None, address=None, snapshot_path=None, timeout_s=180)` — delegate to REA CLI. Kinds: auto, javascript, native_overview/search/function/decompile/xrefs/trace, providers, capabilities, doctor. Outputs over 512 KB truncate with a snapshot hint. See docs/REA.md.

### Directmedia / DKI
- `decode_dki_file(file_path)` — decompress a .DKI with zlib/gzip autodetection. Returns success, strategy_used, text_preview, uncompressed_bytes, attempts.
- `analyze_directmedia_file(file_path)` — full .DKI analysis with text extraction. Writes `*_extracted.txt` beside the file. Returns analysis, extraction_summary, sample_content.
- `decompress_directmedia_library(library_path=None, volume_filter=None)` — batch decompress all volumes in a library. Returns volumes_processed, total_text_extracted, results.
- `digibib_research_snapshot(exe_path=None)` — DigiBib5 static research prelude. Returns file_info, directmedia_string_hits, entropy, tools, next_steps, viewer_roadmap.

### System
- `check_tools()` — check which RE tools are available (Ghidra, radare2, binwalk, strings, file, IDA, REA). Returns tools, summary, notes.
- `shutdown(confirm=False)` — graceful server termination. Requires confirm=True.
- `show_tools_card()` — engine inventory as an in-chat Prefab card (app=True).
- `gym(operation="list", ...)` — cloning-run lifecycle (start/status/advance/stop/list).
- `engine(operation="die"|"capa"|"frida_trace"|"frida_script", ...)` — Detect It Easy compiler/packer ID, capa capabilities, Frida runtime hooks (frida_* need confirm=True; they execute the target).
- `help(level="basic", topic=None)` — multi-level help. Levels: basic, intermediate, advanced. Topics: ghidra, binary, analysis.

## REST API (single FastAPI app on :10750; `uvicorn reversing_mcp.server:app`)

| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| GET /health | Liveness probe. Returns status, version, tool_count. |
| GET /api/v1/diagnostics | Full diagnostics. Returns tools, system info, uptime, errors. |
| GET /api/capabilities | Ports, features, tool inventory. |
| GET /api/skills | List available skills. |
| GET /api/skills/{name} | Get skill content (JSON). |
| GET /skill/{name} | Get skill content (raw text). |
| POST /api/shutdown | Graceful shutdown. |
| POST /analyze/upload | Analyze an uploaded binary (multipart). |
| POST /analyze/file | Analyze a server-side path (`{file_path, tools?}`). |
| GET /tools/status | Engine inventory for Status/Tools pages. |
| GET /ghidra/status | Ghidra install + bridge health. |
| GET /ghidra/instances, POST /ghidra/connect, GET /ghidra/functions, POST /ghidra/decompile, POST /ghidra/disassemble, POST /start_ghidra | Ghidra bridge proxy. |
| POST /llm/list_providers, POST /llm/list_models, POST /llm/select_model, POST /llm/load_model, POST /llm/unload_model, POST /llm/status, POST /llm/health | Ollama provider ops. |
| GET /api/llm/discover, GET /api/llm/providers | Provider auto-discovery (presence, resident-first default, lists). |
| GET /api/llm/models?provider= | Live model list. |
| GET /api/llm/onboarding | Starter facts + recommended path. |
| POST /api/llm/chat | Backend chat proxy (`{provider, model, messages}`). |
| POST /api/v1/chat | Chat (`{message, history, system?, model?}`). |
| GET /api/logs, GET /api/logs/stats, GET /api/logs/export, DELETE /api/logs | In-repo activity log ring buffer. |
| GET /api/v1/digibib/find\|snapshot\|check-idr\|decode-dki\|directmedia-strings | Digibib5/DKI flows. |
| POST /api/v1/gym/runs, GET /api/v1/gym/runs, GET /api/v1/gym/runs/{id}, POST .../advance, POST .../stop, GET .../artifacts/{path} | Gym cloning runs (stages 0/1/4). |
| /mcp | FastMCP HTTP transport endpoint. |
| /docs, /redoc, /openapi.json | Auto API docs. |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| MCP_TRANSPORT | stdio | Transport mode: stdio, http, sse |
| MCP_HOST | 127.0.0.1 | Bind address for HTTP/SSE |
| MCP_PORT | 10750 | Port for HTTP/SSE |
| MCP_PATH | /mcp | HTTP endpoint path |
| GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR | — | Ghidra installation root (for headless) |
| GHIDRA_HOME | — | Alias for GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR |
| GHIDRA_BRIDGE_URL | http://127.0.0.1:8089 | Webapp Ghidra-status proxy target |
| OLLAMA_BASE_URL | http://localhost:11434 | Webapp Chat + LLM discovery |
| DIGITALE_BIBLIOTHEK_ROOT | — | Digitale Bibliothek library root |
| LOG_LEVEL | INFO | Logging level |

## Claude Desktop config

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "reversing-mcp": {
      "command": "uv",
      "args": ["--directory", "D:/Dev/repos/reversing-mcp", "run", "python", "-m", "reversing_mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Architecture

```
server.py (FastMCP 3.4)
  ├── analyzers.py          — BinaryAnalyzer (Ghidra headless, radare2, binwalk, PE, entropy, strings)
  ├── directmedia_dki.py    — DKI decode/decompress (zlib/gzip heuristics)
  ├── digibib_research.py   — DigiBib research snapshot builder
  ├── transport.py          — Dual transport (stdio/HTTP)
  └── logging_config.py     — Logger factory
ghidra_scripts/
  ├── analyze_binary.py     — Ghidra headless analysis script
  ├── decompile_function.py — Ghidra function decompiler script
  └── test_script.py        — Test script
web_sota/                   — SOTA React dashboard (port 10751)
native/                     — Tauri 2.0 NSIS wrapper
```

## Ghidra integration

Two paths:
1. **Interactive** via ReVa MCP (separate server) — decompile, xrefs, rename
2. **Headless** via `analyze_binary(..., ['ghidra'])` — batch analysis

See [docs/GHIDRA.md](docs/GHIDRA.md) for full setup.

## Directmedia mission

The Digitale Bibliothek 5 (Digibib5.exe) and .DKI format are the primary reference test case.  
See [docs/DIRECTMEDIA_MISSION.md](docs/DIRECTMEDIA_MISSION.md), [docs/DIRECTMEDIA_REVERSING_TOOLKIT.md](docs/DIRECTMEDIA_REVERSING_TOOLKIT.md), [docs/DIGIBIB_DECOMPILE_PLAN.md](docs/DIGIBIB_DECOMPILE_PLAN.md).

## Skills

- `primary` — Static binary analysis and Directmedia reversing. Load via `GET /api/skills/primary` or `skill://primary` resource.
